Monologue: Chef! My favorite person in the city. Your tile floor looks divine today. Have I ever told you that?
Svetka's done with the Spoiled in the city. She isn't going to say it, but with the amount of soldiers around now, I think everybody knows it.
But it's like no one cares. As if no one loves the Spoiled. As if no one's bothered by people they love rotting away until they're worse than dead.
All that pain… and what does anyone do? They get stabbed with a pointier and pointier stick until it's virtually a spear— and they complain, but they just sit there.
It's why I can't stand these people —that's one thing I can agree with Svetka on.
Indolent, wailing like an infant to their Lady as the Spoilage eats their families alive. Either commit and rot in your misery…
…Or put yourself on the front page of the newspaper. Speaking of which, Svetka's coming to your diner in two days.
You've attracted enough bedraggled freaks with that charity of yours, have you not?
Maybe feed her some of the grime off their shoulders. I'm sure the populace will build a statue of you in your honor.
